parameters.content:
## ops-db smoke test
Writes one row to `heartbeats`, then reads it back.

Pass: the last node shows `migrations = 001_init` and `seconds_ago` under 1.

Credential: Postgres, host `ops-db`, port 5432, db/user `ops`, SSL disable.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO heartbeats (source, details)
VALUES ('n8n-smoke-test', jsonb_build_object('n8n_execution_id', $1::text))
ON CONFLICT (source) DO UPDATE
   SET last_beat_at = now(),
       details      = EXCLUDED.details
RETURNING source, last_beat_at, details;

SELECT
    (SELECT string_agg(version, ', ' ORDER BY version) FROM schema_migrations) AS migrations,
    h.source,
    h.last_beat_at,
    round(extract(epoch FROM now() - h.last_beat_at)::numeric, 3) AS seconds_ago,
    h.details
FROM heartbeats h
WHERE h.source = 'n8n-smoke-test';
